steps.zh: 同弓形：$\angle BAC = \angle BDC$（都對弧 $BC$）。
steps.en: Same segment: $\angle BAC = \angle BDC$ (arc $BC$).

steps.zh: 兩組對應角相等，加上 $AE = DE$，所以 $\triangle ABE \cong \triangle DCE$（AAS）。
steps.en: Two pairs of corresponding angles are equal, and $AE = DE$. So $\triangle ABE \cong \triangle DCE$ (AAS).

steps.zh: 對應邊相等：$BE = CE$。
steps.en: Corresponding sides: $BE = CE$.

intro.zh: 用兩組同弓形角及已知 AE = DE 證明全等。
intro.en: Use two equal angle pairs and AE = DE to prove congruence.

steps.zh: 先連 $AB$ 與 $CD$；兩隻角都對着弧 $AD$，所以 $\angle ABD = \angle ACD$；同樣都對着弧 $BC$，所以 $\angle BAC = \angle BDC$。
steps.en: $\angle ABD = \angle ACD$ and $\angle BAC = \angle BDC$.

steps.zh: 加上 $AE = DE$（已知）與對頂角，兩三角形全等（AAS）。
steps.en: With $AE = DE$ and the vertically opposite angles, $\triangle ABE \cong \triangle DCE$ (AAS).

steps.zh: 全等三角形的對應邊相等，所以 $BE = CE$。
steps.en: Corresponding sides are equal, so $BE = CE$.

traps.label: (a)
traps.zh: 用 $AE = DE$ 當成邊與邊相等就說三角形全等，沒有寫出兩對角。
traps.en: Using only AE = DE without the two pairs of equal angles.

tip.zh: 要證兩條線段相等，多數是證兩個三角形全等；相交弦給兩對同弓形角。
tip.en: To prove segments equal, prove the triangles congruent; crossing chords give two pairs of equal angles.

stem.en: In the figure, $AC$ is a diameter of the circle $ABCD$. $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at $E$. It is given that $BE = CE$ and $\angle BEC = 104^\circ$. Prove that $AB \parallel DC$.
stem.zh: 圖中 $AC$ 是圓 $ABCD$ 的直徑，$AC$ 與 $BD$ 交於 $E$。已知 $BE = CE$、$\angle BEC = 104^\circ$，證明 $AB \parallel DC$。

note.zh: 同旁內角互補
note.en: Interior angles add to 180°

steps.zh: 已知 $BE = CE$、$\angle BEC = 104^\circ$。
steps.en: Given $BE = CE$ and $\angle BEC = 104^\circ$.

steps.zh: $BE = CE$，所以 $\triangle BCE$ 等腰：$\angle CBE = \angle BCE = \dfrac{180^\circ - 104^\circ}{2} = 38^\circ$。
steps.en: $BE = CE$, so $\triangle BCE$ is isosceles and $\angle CBE = \angle BCE = 38^\circ$.

steps.zh: $AC$ 是直徑，所以 $\angle ABC = 90^\circ$（半圓上的圓周角）；$\angle ABD = 90^\circ - 38^\circ = 52^\circ$。
steps.en: $AC$ is a diameter, so $\angle ABC = 90^\circ$ and $\angle ABD = 52^\circ$.

steps.zh: 同弓形：$\angle ACD = \angle ABD = 52^\circ$。
steps.en: Same segment: $\angle ACD = \angle ABD = 52^\circ$.

steps.zh: 所以 $\angle BCD = 38^\circ + 52^\circ = 90^\circ$，而 $\angle ABC + \angle BCD = 180^\circ$，故 $AB \parallel DC$。
steps.en: So $\angle BCD = 38^\circ + 52^\circ = 90^\circ$, and $\angle ABC + \angle BCD = 180^\circ$, hence $AB \parallel DC$.

intro.zh: 先找等腰三角形的底角，再證同旁內角互補。
intro.en: Find the base angles first. Then show that the interior angles add to 180?.

steps.zh: 已知 $BE = CE$，而且 $\angle BEC = 104^\circ$；先處理等腰三角形 $BCE$ 的兩隻底角。
steps.en: $\angle CBE = \angle BCE = 38^\circ$.

steps.zh: 因為 $BE = CE$，三角形 $BCE$ 是等腰三角形，兩隻底角相等：$\angle CBE = \angle BCE = \dfrac{180^\circ - 104^\circ}{2} = 38^\circ$。
steps.en: $\angle ABC = 90^\circ$, so $\angle ABD = 52^\circ$.

steps.zh: 因為 $AC$ 是直徑，圓周角 $\angle ABC = 90^\circ$，所以 $\angle ABD = 90^\circ - 38^\circ = 52^\circ$。
steps.en: $\angle ACD = 52^\circ$.

steps.zh: $\angle BCD = 38^\circ + 52^\circ = 90^\circ$，而 $\angle ABC = 90^\circ$，同旁內角相加為 $180^\circ$，所以 $AB \parallel DC$。
steps.en: $\angle BCD = 90^\circ$ and $\angle ABC = 90^\circ$, so $AB \parallel DC$.

traps.label: (a)
traps.zh: 把 $\angle BCD$ 只算 $\angle BCE$，忘記加上 $\angle ACD$。
traps.en: Forgetting that ∠BCD = ∠BCE + ∠ACD.

tip.zh: 證明平行：兩隻同旁內角相加 180° 就夠；先把它們各自的來源找出來。
tip.en: To prove parallel lines, show the interior angles add to 180°.

stem.en: In the figure, $ABCD$ is a circle. It is given that $AD \parallel BC$, $BC = CD = 15$ cm, $\angle BAD = 60^\circ$ and $\angle BDC = 30^\circ$. (a) Is $AD$ a diameter of the circle? Explain. (b) Someone claims that the area of $\triangle ABD$ is less than $200$ cm$^2$. Do you agree? Explain.
stem.zh: 圖中 $ABCD$ 是圓。已知 $AD \parallel BC$、$BC = CD = 15$ cm、$\angle BAD = 60^\circ$、$\angle BDC = 30^\circ$。(a) $AD$ 是否圓的直徑？試解釋。(b) 有人聲稱 $\triangle ABD$ 的面積小於 $200$ cm$^2$，你是否同意？試解釋。

parts.label: (b)
parts.en: Is the area of $\triangle ABD$ less than 200 cm$^2$?
parts.zh: $\triangle ABD$ 的面積是否小於 200 cm$^2$？

note.zh: 弧 AB、BC、CD 各 60°，所以弧 AD = 180°
note.en: Arcs AB, BC, CD are 60° each, so arc AD = 180°

note.zh: 半圓上的直角 ＋ ½ × AB × BD
note.en: Right angle in the semi-circle, then ½ × AB × BD

steps.zh: 已知 $AD \parallel BC$、$BC = CD = 15$ cm，及圖中的 $60^\circ$、$30^\circ$。
steps.en: Given $AD \parallel BC$, $BC = CD = 15$ cm, and the marked angles.

steps.zh: $BC = CD$，所以 $\triangle BCD$ 等腰，$\angle CBD = 30^\circ$。
steps.en: $BC = CD$, so the base angles of $\triangle BCD$ are equal: $\angle CBD = 30^\circ$.

steps.zh: 由已知的平行線 $AD \parallel BC$，可得內錯角相等，所以 $\angle ADB = \angle CBD = 30^\circ$。
steps.en: $AD \parallel BC$, so $\angle ADB = \angle CBD = 30^\circ$ (alternate angles).

steps.zh: 在 $\triangle ABD$，$\angle ABD = 180^\circ - 60^\circ - 30^\circ = 90^\circ$。
steps.en: In $\triangle ABD$, $\angle ABD = 180^\circ - 60^\circ - 30^\circ = 90^\circ$.

steps.zh: （a）$\angle ABD = 90^\circ$，所以 $AD$ 是直徑（半圓定理的逆定理）。
steps.en: (a) $\angle ABD = 90^\circ$, so $AD$ is a diameter (converse of the semi-circle theorem).

steps.zh: （b）現在才標出圓心 $O$，連 $OC$。$\angle ODC = 30^\circ + 30^\circ = 60^\circ$。
steps.en: (b) Now mark the centre $O$ and join $OC$. $\angle ODC = 30^\circ + 30^\circ = 60^\circ$.

steps.zh: $OC = OD$（半徑），故 OCD 的三隻角都是 $60^\circ$，是等邊三角形。
steps.en: Since $OC = OD$ (radii), all three angles of OCD are $60^\circ$. OCD is equilateral.

steps.zh: $OD = CD = 15$ cm，所以直徑 $AD = 30$ cm。
steps.en: $OD = CD = 15$ cm, so the diameter $AD = 30$ cm.

steps.zh: 回到直角三角形 ABD：$AB = 30\sin 30^\circ = 15$ cm；$BD = 15\tan 60^\circ = 15\sqrt{3}$ cm。
steps.en: In right-angled ABD, $AB = 30\sin 30^\circ = 15$ cm and $BD = 15\tan 60^\circ = 15\sqrt{3}$ cm.

steps.zh: 面積 $= \tfrac12 \times AB \times BD = 112.5\sqrt{3} \approx 194.9$ cm$^2 < 200$ cm$^2$，所以同意。
steps.en: Area $= \tfrac12 \times AB \times BD = 112.5\sqrt{3} \approx 194.9$ cm$^2 < 200$ cm$^2$. So we agree.

intro.zh: 先在 ABD 內證明直角；之後才引入圓心和半徑。
intro.en: Prove the right angle in ABD first. Then introduce the centre and radii.

steps.zh: 已知 $BC = CD$，三角形 $BCD$ 是等腰三角形，兩隻底角相等：$\angle CBD = \angle BDC = 30^\circ$。
steps.en: $BC = CD$, so $\angle CBD = 30^\circ$.

steps.zh: 由已知的平行線 $AD \parallel BC$，可得內錯角相等，所以 $\angle ADB = \angle CBD = 30^\circ$。
steps.en: $AD \parallel BC$, so $\angle ADB = \angle CBD = 30^\circ$ (alternate angles).

title.en: Prove a right angle, then a diameter

steps.zh: 在 $\triangle ABD$，$\angle ABD = 90^\circ$。根據半圓定理的逆定理，$AD$ 是直徑。
steps.en: In $\triangle ABD$, $\angle ABD = 90^\circ$. By the converse of the semi-circle theorem, $AD$ is a diameter.

title.en: Find the radius using an equilateral triangle

steps.zh: 標出圓心 $O$，連 $OC$。$\angle ODC = 30^\circ + 30^\circ = 60^\circ$。由 $OC = OD$，可得 OCD 的三角皆為 $60^\circ$，故它是等邊三角形。於是 $OD = CD = 15$ cm，$AD = 30$ cm。
steps.en: Mark the centre $O$ and join $OC$. $\angle ODC = 60^\circ$ and $OC = OD$, so OCD is equilateral. Thus $OD = CD = 15$ cm and $AD = 30$ cm.

steps.zh: 在直角三角形 ABD 中，利用三角比求兩條直角邊：$AB = AD\sin30^\circ = 15$ cm，$BD = AB\tan60^\circ = 15\sqrt3$ cm。
steps.en: In right-angled ABD, $AB = AD\sin30^\circ = 15$ cm and $BD = AB\tan60^\circ = 15\sqrt3$ cm.

steps.zh: 三角形 $ABD$ 的面積 $= \tfrac{1}{2} \times AB \times BD = 112.5\sqrt{3} \approx 195$ cm$^2$，小於 200，所以同意。
steps.en: Area $= 112.5\sqrt{3} \approx 195 < 200$, so agree.

traps.label: (a)
traps.zh: 只寫 $\angle BAD = 60^\circ$ 就說 $AD$ 是直徑，沒有證明弧 $AD = 180^\circ$。
traps.en: Jumping from ∠BAD = 60° to "diameter" without showing arc AD = 180°.

traps.label: (b)
traps.zh: 用 $\tfrac{1}{2} \times 30 \times 15$ 之類的底高配搭，但高不是 15。
traps.en: Using 30 and 15 as base and height — 15 is a side, not the height.

tip.zh: 先用等腰三角形及內錯角找出 ADB，再用內角和證明 ABD 是直角。證明直徑後，才用等邊三角形求半徑及面積。
tip.en: Find ADB using the equal sides and parallel lines. Use the angle sum to prove ABD = 90°. Then use an equilateral triangle to find the radius and area.
